jobs.title: [Founder's Office] Chief of Staff to the CEO
jobs.description:
About Enterpret

At Enterpret, we are building the platform that unifies customer feedback from every channel into a single, structured, real-time source of truth, so the world's best product development teams always know what their customers need. We solve complex problems in natural language processing, serverless computing, and analytics, pushing the envelope of what's possible by applying first-principle thinking.

We're backed by investors who share our conviction, Peak XV, Canaan Partners and Kleiner Perkins, and trusted by some of the most respected product development teams in the world, including Notion, Canva, ElevenLabs, Apollo, Flow, Descript, Samsung, Western Union, Fanatics, Atlassian, Ancestry and The Farmer's Dog.

We love working with folks who are resourceful, thrive in ambiguity, and display a strong sense of ownership.

Read more about our team, core values, and operating principles - here .

What You'll Do

- Partner directly with our CEO and founding team as a true extension of the CEO: a trusted sounding board and proxy who represents them in rooms they can't be in, makes calls on their behalf, and turns founder intent into scoped workstreams with clear owners, timelines, and follow-through.

- Protect and prioritize the CEO's focus by deciding what needs their attention and quietly handling what doesn't, while preparing them for board meetings, investor conversations, and high-stakes decisions .

- Own finance-adjacent operating work, including vendor decisions, budget tracking, cash-conscious prioritization, and analyses that help the CEO make sharper calls.

- Run the company's operating rhythm across leadership meetings, weekly business reviews, and planning cycles, setting agendas, surfacing the right data, and tracking every decision to close.

- Take messy operational projects off the CEO's plate and run them independently across people, process, finance, and vendor workflows.

- Build the analyses and narratives that move decisions forward: first-draft strategy memos, board and investor materials, and company-wide communications, grounded in first- and third-party data .

- Operate AI-natively by using modern AI tooling to research, draft, model, and automate the work, and help the leadership team adopt AI-enabled ways of working as we scale.

- Take first sales calls and earn real commercial reps by learning our ICP, their pain points, and where Enterpret wins, so you can build conviction on the question that runs the business: how do we grow ARR?

- Step in as temporary owner on the highest-priority cross-functional problems, collaborating across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering wherever there's a gap between strategy and execution .

What It Takes

- 5+ years in a high-agency role, such as startup operating, management consulting, investment banking, venture capital, or strategy/business operations, where you owned ambiguous, high-stakes work end to end.

- Early-stage startup operating experience is strongly preferred; ex-founder experience is a strong plus.

- A track record of growing your own mandate : you've walked into an undefined problem and walked out with a system, a decision, or an outcome the team now relies on.

- Strong analytical and data fluency , comfortable in spreadsheets, building models, and reasoning from data, and AI-native in how you work, using modern AI tools to move faster and go deeper.

- Sharp written and verbal communication : you can write a crisp memo one day and represent the CEO in the room the next.

- Commercially minded and energized by customers, willing to take sales calls , learn the product cold, and build conviction directly from the market.

- A track record of collaborating across functions and earning trust without relying on formal authority.

- Energized by building culture through rituals, operating cadence, communication, and follow-through.

- High ownership, sound judgment with sensitive information, and genuinely energized by startup ambiguity and variety, where no two weeks look the same.

Why Enterpret?

- High Impact: Work at the center of the company alongside the CEO, on the decisions that set our direction and grow ARR.

- Ownership: End-to-end responsibility for the initiatives and outcomes you take on.

- Complex Challenges: Range across strategy, go-to-market, operations, and analytics. The variety is the job.

- Growth: A genuine launchpad into functional leadership. The last person in this seat used it to move into a specialized Growth role.

- Culture: Open, collaborative, and values-driven environment with autonomy.

- Benefits: Competitive salary, equity, hybrid work setup, premium healthcare, and more.

What We Value

At Enterpret, we operate with a deep sense of ownership. We play for the team and do what it takes to win together. We care personally for our teammates while pushing each other with honest, actionable feedback. Above all, we approach everything with humility and a drive to keep learning and getting better.

Equal Opportunities

We are an equal opportunity employer. We ensure that none of our employees or prospective employees receives less favourable treatment as a result of age, sex, disability, marital status, colour, race, religion or ethnic origin. Equally we aim to ensure that no such employee is disadvantaged by terms and conditions of employment which cannot be justified.

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Enterpret

As the world moves to AI native applications, one element matters more than anything: the data. At Enterpret, we are unlocking the most impactful dataset for businesses, customer feedback. We centralize feedback across every source, like Twitter, Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack, Intercom, community forums, surveys, and Gong calls, into a single knowledge graph. On top of it we build an adaptive taxonomy for each customer and an agent platform that lets teams query, monitor, and act on customer intelligence wherever they work, whether that's inside Enterpret, in Slack, or in their own AI tools through our MCP server.

Our customers include companies like Canva, Notion, WisprFlow, ElevenLabs, OpenRouter, Western Union, and several other Product Led Growth decacorns and F500 companies.We are backed by Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia Capital India, and Unusual Ventures. Read more about our team, core values, and operating principles here .

The Role

We've built the agentic platform to deploy self improving customer experiences. Now we build systems that scale those solutions.How our CSMs actually work

- The buck stops with you. You will own and be accountable for the success of your customers. Not their happiness, their success.

- You own a number. CSMs at Enterpret carry real business targets. No red/yellow/green theater.

- Your operating rhythm is agent-led. Portfolio reviews, renewal prep, onboarding status, and upsell forecasting run on agents built against our own Knowledge Graph. You review, correct, and act on what the agents surface, and you improve the agents when they miss.

- You build the automation you wish you had. Our CSMs write and maintain their own agent skills: account briefs before every call, exec engagement mapping, usage reports for renewal conversations, churn risk sweeps, case study drafts. If you do something manually twice, we expect you to ask whether an agent should do it the third time.

- You deploy agents with your customers, not just for yourself. The product you support is an agent platform. You will help customers connect to Claude/Codex/Factory and their other AI tools through MCP, stand up custom agents on their feedback data (support QA coaches, VoC digests, launch monitors), and turn those into the use cases that drive renewal and expansion.

- You tell stories with data. Monthly and quarterly reviews are grounded in evidence from the customer's own feedback: quantified themes, quotes, and outcomes, not usage screenshots.

What Customer Success at Enterpret is

- Driving positive business outcomes for our customers. Increased revenue, reduced churn, and better user activation are more meaningful than monthly active users.

- Providing value that goes above and beyond what is currently possible within the product itself. We are the external representatives of our company, and we solve our customers' problems even when the product isn't quite there yet, increasingly by building agents that close the gap.

- Owning a full book of business from onboarding through activation, renewal, and upsell. We aim to build multi-year partnerships with our customers. We are not transactional.

- Being an advocate for our customers so that our product and engineering teams continue to build the right products for them. What better way to validate product ideas than to prove they are useful?

What Customer Success at Enterpret is NOT

- Only caring about vanity metrics like usage statistics or red/yellow/green statuses

- Being strictly reactive and waiting for our customers to bring us problems

- Being a human ticket router. We built a Scaled Success function and AI support agent so you don't have to be.

- Doing absolutely everything a customer asks for, regardless of whether it is the optimal solution for them

A successful candidate will

- Have owned a revenue number (NRR, expansion, or renewal) for an enterprise or PLG book of business and be able to walk through how they hit it

- Be a hands-on daily user of AI tools like Claude, and be genuinely excited to build agent workflows rather than just talk about them. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be the kind of person who automates their own job.

- Be a strong data storyteller who can turn feedback data into an executive narrative that lands in an EBR

- Have a strong sense of ownership and a desire to make an impact at an early stage startup

- Be eager to learn and raise their hand to solve hard problems

- Be excited to meet our customers in person

- Go above and beyond whatever we could write in a job description

Benefits and Perks

- Autonomy and ownership of an early-stage startup

- Highly competitive compensation and early-stage startup equity

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

- Comprehensive benefits package, including 401(k)

- Generous vacation policy

- Maternity and Paternity leaves

Equal Opportunities

We are an equal opportunity employer. We ensure that none of our employees or prospective employees receives less favorable treatment as a result of age, sex, disability, marital status, colour, race, religion or ethnic origin. Equally we aim to ensure that no such employee is disadvantaged by terms and conditions of employment which cannot be justified.How to ApplyFill out the form below, submit your resume, and share an example of why you will be an exceptional CSM. Bonus points if it involves an agent or automation you built that made your customers (or you) measurably better, or your favorite come-from-behind Customer Success story of the last two years
